about:
We Are More was founded in 1984 in Lahaina, Hawaii, and remains a locally owned and operated business serving the Hawaiian islands. The company began as a technology integration firm focused on sound and acoustical treatment before expanding into a full-range smart systems provider.

The firm consults, designs, manufactures, installs, and manages a broad portfolio including acoustical treatment, telecommunications, security, solar, Wi-Fi, cable networking, voice over IP, computer networks, network security, home theater, digital signage, lighting, locks, shades, blinds, SCADA, energy monitoring, and automation. It holds a DOE vendor number (149246), a CAGE code (81P78) for military, federal, and state contracting, and a Hawaii contractor’s license (C-35167). No facility size or headcount figures are disclosed.

We Are More serves residential, commercial, and marine customers across the Big Island, Maui County, Oahu, and Kauai. Its client base includes federal agencies, the military, state government, and private homeowners and businesses seeking integrated smart technology solutions.

The company emphasizes its end-to-end service model—from consultation through installation and ongoing management—and its readiness for government contracting at all levels as key differentiators.
